text:
maria: Postmortem done for rate-limiter OOS. Suggest we update the runbook with explicit triage steps, concrete commands, and an escalation matrix. TL;DR: recurring mem growth pattern ~72h. Need owners + timelines.
alex: +1. Can you paste the remediation commands we ran? I can add them directly to the runbook.
maria: Primary commands we used: ```
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=rlb -o wide
kubectl -n prod exec -it pod/rlb-xyz -- /bin/sh -c 'ps aux | grep rlb'
``` Also `rbctl flush-cache --cluster prod` and `rbctl metrics cache_size`.
sanjay: For escalation, propose:
- >=5% 5xx for 2m -> paging-sre (P1)
- sustained increase for 10m -> oncall + ENG lead (P0?)
- errors still after 15m -> trigger rollback / activate incident playbook
Who owns these policy thresholds?
lily: I can own runbook additions. Can we set due date EOD Friday?
alex: Assigning action items:
- Add triage section + commands -> lily (due 2026-03-27)
- Add escalation matrix + pager thresholds -> sanjay (due 2026-03-29)
- Add automated Grafana alert doc snippets -> alex (due 2026-03-30)
I'll make PR in infra/runbooks and link it here.
incident-bot: Created task https://redwood/tasks/1234 assigned to lily, sanjay, alex. Reminder set for 3 days.
maria: Note — recurring pattern every ~72h when cache grows. Add step to check KV cache metrics `rbctl metrics cache_size` and eviction command: `rbctl cache-evict --all`.
sanjay: Also recommend adding automatic fallback policy notes: how to change routing to `model-variant-lowmem` if mem >80% on GPU nodes, and include CLI snippet for that.
lily: I'll draft the PR today. Quick Q: who's the reviewer? @alex?
alex: Yup I'll review. If urgent, ping me in DM.
maria: Small follow-ups: tie these action items back into the postmortem doc, mark owners in the postmortem and update the incident label (runbook-needed).
sanjay: Logging/debugging note: include core dump steps in runbook: `gcore -o /tmp/rlb $(pidof rlb)` and upload path + how to attach to task.
lily: Ack. PR will include commands, example outputs, checklist, and alert snippets.
alex: I'll add a canary rollback snippet and a one-page escalation flowchart image to the PR.
maria: Thanks all — once PR is merged, ops will run the checklist in the next simulated warmup.
